summary: Phaos Technology Holdings, a Cayman exempted company, filed a 6-K furnishing notice of an Extraordinary General Meeting reconvened for August 31, 2026. Proposals include increasing authorized share capital from US$100,000 to US$10 billion via creation of trillions of new shares, and consolidating every fifteen ordinary shares into one share with a higher par value. Fractional shares will be rounded up. No strategic transaction is identified; these are routine capital-structure adjustments. The 6-K is incorporated by reference into the company's S-8 registration statement.
